shared_elements: schematic living creatures or body-like forms
justification: The only real correspondences are generic: both include schematic animate forms and some repeated geometric/circular motifs, with the closest shared element being small oval or circular signs used as part of the decoration. The major difference is that A is a single concentric circular emblem enclosing a frontal central figure, while B is a vertical field of separate profile animals and signs arranged in horizontal registers.
